global_feedback: Library is internally inconsistent with the request for 65 final seeds: only 49 sequence entries are present, and several planned IDs are missing entirely.
Many seeds mix incompatible framing styles or contain implausible nested/repeated 0x68 starts inside a single message without a clear complete FT1.2 structure.
A substantial fraction of messages have suspicious or likely incorrect length relationships relative to the payload bytes, despite repeated claims of consistency.
Several seeds are near-cosmetic variants with minimal structural change, especially families sharing the same long payload and only changing one byte.
Some expected_behavior text overclaims effects such as confirmations, resets, or clock/session actions that are not justified by the supplied internal-only evidence.
Useful conservative U-frame style seeds exist, but they are diluted by many malformed or low-plausibility frames that reduce corpus quality for Base seeds.
Deterministic duplicate removals are acknowledged, but duplicate-like constructions and repeated payload templates remain.
Need stronger curation: keep only clearly well-formed conservative frames, remove malformed hybrids, and fill missing plan coverage with structurally distinct seeds.

coverage_gaps: Missing 16 planned seeds; final library should contain 65 reviewed sequences but does not.
Need consistent separation of chosen framing family: avoid mixing malformed FT1.2-like hybrids with APCI-style U/I frames in the same seed unless clearly complete.
Need more clearly plausible complete application-layer I-frames for interrogation, read, command, measured/report, and clock sync operations.
Need additional server_to_client response seeds beyond minimal U-frame confirmations to improve direction diversity.
Need at least a few conservative supervisory/S-frame style examples if supported by internal prior, instead of many malformed pseudo-application frames.
Need structurally distinct payload sizes and object layouts, not repeated templates with one-byte changes.
Need stricter validation of every 0x68 length byte against actual remaining bytes before inclusion.
Need removal of seeds with embedded secondary 0x68 starts, stray terminal 0x68 bytes, or unsupported claims about checksums/resets/confirmations.
